prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Desktop Companion Quick Controls", "Discover how to summon, minimize, and chat with your desktop pet effortlessly."]
1: ["Sign In to Sync & Protect Your Pets", "Ensure your desktop pet data is safely synced to your cloud account."]
2: ["Preparing Desktop Environment", "Verifying screen display permissions and pet animation renderer."]
3: ["Select Your Ideal Desktop Companion", "Compare companion behaviors and choose the pet that suits your desktop background."]
4: ["How Would You Like to Get Your Desktop Pet?", "Adopt a ready-to-play companion or build a custom pet using your own photos."]
5: ["Your Desktop Companion is Ready to Launch", "Review your pet setup summary and spawn your companion on screen."]
6: ["Tip: Once ready, your pet can freely wander your desktop or stay anchored to active windows."]
7: ["Upload clear, well-lit photos focused on your pet for optimal 3D generation accuracy."]
8: ["Your pet collection and setup progress will automatically back up to your account."]
9: ["Includes Free Interactive Desktop Accessories"]
